skill.summary: Toggle features instantly without deploying code. A/B test variants, gradual rollouts from 1% to 100%, and emergency kill switches for AI agents.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of feature-flag-manager.
- Instantly toggle features on/off without deploying code.
- Support for gradual rollouts and percentage-based enablement (1% to 100%).
- Built-in A/B testing with variant distribution and user targeting.
- Emergency kill switch to immediately disable buggy features.
- Includes CLI commands for feature creation, updates, status checks, and exporting config.
